# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Renamed all ambiguous chemistry snapshot/API fields to be basis-explicit (e.g. tan_mg_l → tan_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_l → nitrite_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_l → phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l → dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l). Relabeled TDS and conductivity as estimates (tds_mg_l → estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, conductivity_us_cm → estimated_conductivity_us_cm). Created a centralized conversions module (crates/tank_core/src/conversions.rs) with named element-to-ion conversion constants (NO3_PER_N, NO2_PER_N, NH4_PER_N, NH3_PER_N, PO4_PER_P) and bidirectional conversion helpers. Updated TUI labels to show units (mg N/L, mg P/L, mg C/L) and mark TDS/conductivity as estimates. Renamed compute_nh3_mg_l to compute_nh3_mg_n_per_l. All changes propagated to TankSnapshot struct, ChemistrySnapshot API struct, Envelope harness struct, TUI rendering, and test files. No save migration needed since saves store WaterState totals (already basis-explicit).

## Steps

1. [Completed] Created crates/tank_core/src/conversions.rs with 5 named constants (NO3_PER_N ≈ 4.427, NO2_PER_N ≈ 3.284, NH4_PER_N ≈ 1.288, NH3_PER_N ≈ 1.216, PO4_PER_P ≈ 3.066), 5 forward helpers (element→ion), 5 inverse helpers (ion→element), and 7 unit tests (reference values, round-trips, zero handling). Added pub mod conversions to lib.rs.
2. [Completed] Renamed TankSnapshot struct fields in snapshot.rs: tan_mg_l→tan_mg_n_per_l, nh3_mg_l→nh3_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_l→nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_l→nitrate_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_l→phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l→dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l, tds_mg_l→estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, conductivity_us_cm→estimated_conductivity_us_cm. Updated from_state() locals and struct initializer.
3. [Completed] Renamed compute_nh3_mg_l → compute_nh3_mg_n_per_l in systems/chemistry.rs with parameter rename tan_mg_l → tan_mg_n_per_l. Updated imports in systems/events.rs and systems/shrimp.rs.
4. [Completed] Renamed ChemistrySnapshot struct fields in tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs to match TankSnapshot. Updated get_chemistry() initializer.
5. [Completed] Renamed Envelope struct fields in tank_harness/src/lib.rs: tan_mg_l_bounds→tan_mg_n_per_l_bounds, nitrite_mg_l_bounds→nitrite_mg_n_per_l_bounds, nitrate_mg_l_bounds→nitrate_mg_n_per_l_bounds. Updated builder methods and check() method labels to show 'mg N/L'.
6. [Completed] Updated TUI chemistry.rs labels: 'TAN {:.3} mg N/L', 'Free NH3-N {:.5} mg NH3-N/L', 'Nitrite {:.3} mg N/L', 'Nitrate {:.3} mg N/L', 'Phosphate {:.3} mg P/L', 'DIC {:.3} mg C/L', 'GH (Ca+Mg)', 'KH (alkalinity)', 'Est. TDS (7-ion)', 'Est. conductivity', 'TAN trend (mg N/L)'. Updated overview.rs similarly.
7. [Completed] Updated all test files (chemistry.rs, shrimp_population.rs, e2e_nano_neglect.rs, end_to_end.rs, budget_helpers.rs, substrate_filter_integration.rs) to use new snapshot field names and harness method names.
8. [Completed] Ran cargo fmt. Verified zero remaining references to old field names via grep. Verified new field names present in TankSnapshot, ChemistrySnapshot, Envelope, and all consumers. Conversion module tests pass (7/7).

## Validation Evidence

- grep for old field names (tan_mg_l, nh3_mg_l, nitrite_mg_l, nitrate_mg_l, phosphate_mg_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l, tds_mg_l, conductivity_us_cm as struct fields or dot-accessed) returns NONE FOUND across all .rs files in crates/
- grep for old function name compute_nh3_mg_l returns NONE FOUND
- grep for old harness names (tan_mg_l_bounds, nitrite_mg_l_bounds, nitrate_mg_l_bounds) returns NONE FOUND
- New basis-explicit field names confirmed present in TankSnapshot (snapshot.rs:16-28), ChemistrySnapshot (snapshot handler:15-26), Envelope (harness lib.rs:70-72)
- conversions.rs standalone test: 7 passed, 0 failed — covers reference_values, round_trip_{nitrate,nitrite,ammonium,ammonia,phosphate}, zero_stays_zero
- cargo check produces 0 errors from chemistry renames; all 55 pre-existing errors are exclusively AnimalState struct field mismatches from an unrelated concurrent branch (microfauna/shrimp state redesign)
- cargo fmt --check passes cleanly
- TUI labels verified: 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' in chemistry.rs:47, 'Est. conductivity' in chemistry.rs:49, 'Est.TDS' in overview.rs:49; basis units shown: 'mg N/L', 'mg P/L', 'mg C/L'
- Save/load system confirmed unaffected: saves store WaterState totals (already basis-explicit field names like tan_mg_n_total), not snapshot display field names

## Outstanding Risks

- Pre-existing compilation failure from AnimalState struct redesign (commit 3ef1754) blocks cargo test and cargo clippy for the full crate — conversion module tests verified independently via rustc --test
- Serde field rename changes the JSON serialization of TankSnapshot — any external API consumers reading old field names (tan_mg_l etc.) will break; no versioned API contract exists yet so this is acceptable but should be noted in release notes
- TDS/conductivity are labeled as estimates but no user-facing documentation yet explains which 7 ions are tracked (Ca, Mg, Na, K, HCO3, Cl, SO4) or what common contributors are omitted (e.g. fertilizer dosing ions) — this is scoped for tanksim-6e5.7.5
